why: #391. `i.ping()` on an `Impl` whose `ping` is declared on its supertype `Base`, not on `Impl` itself. `_settle_calls` used to drop this outright: the receiver's own type is declared, but does not declare the member, and the `IMPLEMENTS` edge already recorded for the same batch was never consulted. Inheritance plus an instance call is the most ordinary shape in the language, so the drop was a real recall loss on every real graph, not a rare corpus corner — and no prior corpus case exercised inheritance together with an instance call at all.
